aller.note: Traditional group 3; the upstream conjugator's internal group 1 is not the requested pedagogical classification.

descendre.note: The upstream raw type lists avoir only; ordinary intransitive use also takes être.

accourir.note: Both ordinary auxiliaries are attested; upstream lists only avoir.

demeurer.note: Ordinary auxiliary depends on meaning; upstream lists only avoir.

ressortir.note: Homographic group-2 and group-3 uses require sense separation before assigning one traditional group to this source lemma.
